svg.text: Three screens that decide whether this works
Commerce → Products · Commerce → Order detail · Website → Puck Studio — one shell, one login
46 rows · filters · inline price and stock edit
Row opens a side panel: variants · media · attributes · SEO
each with its own stock, price, barcode
Simple products stay one row — no variant tax on the 148.
threshold per warehouse · alert in the OS, not email-only
one screen: items, money breakdown, actions, timeline
customer page · CRM deal · accounts ledger
drag blocks, bind data, publish — no HTML files
Publish writes JSON → pages / page_blocks → Blade renders → cached 20 ms
If these three screens are right, the rest is repetition:
products, variants, stock, media — one admin
one calculator, integer paisa, 14 golden tests
Puck JSON rendered by the OS, publish + rollback
